CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNT_TRU
AS
BEGIN

--GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
AS(
    SELECT 
     BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BTP.PORTFOLIO_NAME AS CustomerAccountName
    ,BTPS.INCEPTION_DATE AS CustomerAccountOpenedDate
    ,BTP.SUB_BR_CD AS BranchId
    ,BTP.BASE_NO AS BaseAccountId
    ,BTP.ACC_NO AS InternalAccountId
    ,BTP.LAST6_BASE_NO AS Last6AccountNumber
    ,BTPD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BTP.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
    ,BTP.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO_DELTA BTPD
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO BTP on BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO = BTPD.PORTFOLIO_NO AND BTP.BASE_NO = BTPD.BASE_NO AND  BTP.ACC_NO = BTPD.ACC_NO AND BTP.isLatest = '1'
    LEFT JOIN BUSC.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION BTPS ON BTP.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = BTPS.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AND BTP.BASE_NO = BTPS.BASE_NO
    WHERE BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
    BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO
    ,BTP.PORTFOLIO_NAME
    ,BTPS.INCEPTION_DATE
    ,BTP.SUB_BR_CD
    ,BTP.BASE_NO
    ,BTP.ACC_NO
    ,BTP.LAST6_BASE_NO
    ,BTPD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BTP.INSERT_DTTM
    ,BTP.BNK_CODE
 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;

--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
        CustomerAccountId
        ,CustomerAccountName
        ,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
        ,BranchId
        ,BaseAccountId
        ,InternalAccountId
        ,Last6AccountNumber
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,BaseAccountId,InternalAccountId, RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
        CustomerAccountId
        ,CustomerAccountName
        ,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
        ,BranchId
        ,BaseAccountId
        ,InternalAccountId
        ,Last6AccountNumber
    )) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId,BaseAccountId,InternalAccountId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'

),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.BaseAccountId,TGT.BaseAccountId) AS BaseAccountId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.InternalAccountId,TGT.InternalAccountId) AS InternalAccountId
    ,CASE
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS

    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_SRC SRC
    FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
    AND SRC.BaseAccountId = TGT.BaseAccountId
    AND SRC.InternalAccountId = TGT.InternalAccountId
    WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT
SET
[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,[CustomerAccountName] = SRC.CustomerAccountName
,[CustomerAccountOpenedDate] = SRC.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,[CustomerAccountClosedDate] = NULL
,[GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber] = NULL
,[CustomerId] = NULL
,[ResponsibilityCenterId] = NULL
,[SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId] = NULL
,[LedgerId] = NULL
,[LedgerAccountNumber] = NULL
,[IsoCurrencyCode] = NULL
,[CustomerAccountTypeId] = NULL
,[CustomerAccountApplicationNumber] = NULL
,[FinancialinstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialinstitutionId
,[BranchId] = SRC.BranchId
,[BaseAccountId] = SRC.BaseAccountId
,[InternalAccountId] = SRC.InternalAccountId
,[Last6AccountNumber] = SRC.Last6AccountNumber
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'TRU'
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = SRC.InsertDttm
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA DELTA on DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND  DELTA.BaseAccountId = TGT.BaseAccountId AND  DELTA.InternalAccountId = TGT.InternalAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount SRC on SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND  SRC.BaseAccountId = TGT.BaseAccountId AND  SRC.InternalAccountId = TGT.InternalAccountId;

--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccount(
[CustomerAccountId]
,[CustomerAccountName]
,[CustomerAccountOpenedDate]
,[CustomerAccountClosedDate]
,[GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber]
,[CustomerId]
,[ResponsibilityCenterId]
,[SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId]
,[LedgerId]
,[LedgerAccountNumber]
,[IsoCurrencyCode]
,[CustomerAccountTypeId]
,[CustomerAccountApplicationNumber]
,[BranchId]
,[BaseAccountId]
,[InternalAccountId]
,[Last6AccountNumber]
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDTTM]

)

SELECT
CustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountName
,CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,NULL AS CustomerAccountClosedDate
,NULL AS GlobalServiceRelationshipNumber
,NULL AS CustomerId
,NULL AS ResponsibilityCenterId
,NULL AS SubaccountOfCustomerAccountId
,NULL AS LedgerId
,NULL AS LedgerAccountNumber
,NULL AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS CustomerAccountTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountApplicationNumber
,BranchId
,[BaseAccountId]
,[InternalAccountId]
,[Last6AccountNumber]
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONId
,'TRU' AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM

FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccount_DELTA;

END
